scripts.deploy:backend: rsync -rv --delete backend/ root@sydney.emom.me:/opt/emom/website-test/backend/ && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'chown -R emom:www-data /opt/emom/website-test/backend && find /opt/emom/website-test/backend -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && find /opt/emom/website-test/backend -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +'
scripts.deploy:dev: rsync -rv --delete --exclude=".DS_Store" _site/ root@sydney.emom.me:/var/www/html/test.emom.me/ && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'chown -R emom:www-data /var/www/html/test.emom.me && find /var/www/html/test.emom.me -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && find /var/www/html/test.emom.me -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +' && rsync -rv --delete --exclude=".DS_Store" backend/ root@sydney.emom.me:/opt/emom/website-test/backend/ && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'chown -R emom:www-data /opt/emom/website-test/backend && find /opt/emom/website-test/backend -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && find /opt/emom/website-test/backend -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +' && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'systemctl restart emom-test-backend'
scripts.deploy:prod: rsync -rv --delete --exclude=".DS_Store" _site/ root@sydney.emom.me:/var/www/html/sydney.emom.me/ && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'chown -R emom:www-data /var/www/html/sydney.emom.me && find /var/www/html/sydney.emom.me -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && find /var/www/html/sydney.emom.me -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +' && rsync -rv --delete --exclude=".DS_Store" backend/ root@sydney.emom.me:/opt/emom/website/backend/ && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'chown -R emom:www-data /opt/emom/website/backend && find /opt/emom/website/backend -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && find /opt/emom/website/backend -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +' && ssh root@sydney.emom.me 'systemctl restart emom-backend'
